session.title: Connect with E-Flux session export
session.description:
1. Sign in to https://dashboard.e-flux.io using Chrome on a computer.

2. In the same tab, open the console with **⌘ + ⌥ + J** on Mac or **Ctrl + Shift + J** on Windows/Linux.

3. Run: `copy([sessionStorage.getItem('e_flux_jwt') || localStorage.getItem('e_flux_jwt'), localStorage.getItem('e_flux_device_token')].join('|'))`

4. Return here and paste the complete export. Home Assistant stores the paired values and renews them automatically. Do not share this export; it grants access to your account.
